quality_guards: Aviation lithium-battery risk depends on chemistry, energy rating, condition, packaging, terminal protection, baggage location, airline approval and handling.
CAA lithium-battery evidence is battery-, device-, baggage-, operator- and flight-specific and is not an exact parcel-level fire probability.
Laser-event risk depends on laser power and wavelength, distance, angle, cockpit exposure, flight phase, crew composition and local response.
CAA laser evidence is event-, aircraft-, crew-, location- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level aviation-incident probability.
Passenger-information effectiveness depends on airport layout, passenger flow, display visibility, language, screen timing and staff processes.
Dangerous-goods communication evidence is airport-, operator-, passenger-, item- and journey-specific and is not an exact parcel-level flight-safety probability.
Tramway risk depends on alignment, street integration, traffic interaction, stops, signalling, speed, passenger behaviour and local operating conditions.
ORR tramway evidence is system-, location-, vehicle-, road-user- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level collision probability.
Capsize risk depends on vessel design, loading, freeboard, centre of gravity, sea state, lifting, modifications and operational decisions.
MCA stability evidence is vessel-, load-, operation-, weather- and voyage-specific and is not an exact parcel-level capsize probability.
Life-saving performance depends on vessel type, equipment specification, inspection, stowage, compatibility, training, weather and casualty condition.
MCA life-saving evidence is vessel-, equipment-, crew-, environment- and incident-specific and is not an exact parcel-level survival probability.
Leptospirosis risk depends on animal reservoirs, water contamination, rainfall, skin condition, exposure route, duration and protective measures.
UKHSA leptospirosis evidence is exposure-, environment-, occupation-, organism- and person-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infection probability.
Hantavirus risk depends on virus and host species, geography, rodent activity, aerosol or contact exposure, cleaning method and individual factors.
UKHSA hantavirus evidence is virus-, host-, location-, exposure- and person-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infection probability.
Battery fire risk depends on cell design, manufacturing quality, compatibility, damage, charging behaviour, storage, modification and escape-route conditions.
OPSS e-bike evidence is product-, battery-, charger-, premises-, use- and incident-specific and is not an exact parcel-level fire probability.
Button-battery risk depends on cell size and chemistry, product enclosure, accessibility, warnings, user age, ingestion timing and clinical response.
OPSS button-battery evidence is product-, battery-, user-, exposure- and response-specific and is not an exact parcel-level injury probability.
